hotSignals.action: ⭐ CALL HIM THIS MORNING, not after - what has the buyer already seen in Helena, and what is the 12:30 slot competing against. hotSignals.signal: ⭐ LAST NIGHT'S TOUR CAME BACK AT 11:18 THIS MORNING AND IT IS THE MOST USEFUL READ THIS HOUSE HAS PRODUCED. Susan B. And in the box asking for a price-change recommendation she typed, verbatim: "House seemed dirty and the electrical seemed to be glitching." She put a CONDITION objection where a number belongs, and separately validated the number. That is the second independent agent in a week to call this price just right.
hotSignals.action: 🔴 THE ELECTRICAL IS THE ITEM. "Glitching" on a $559,000 house that just fell out of contract for a reason nobody has ever established is worth an electrician before the next tour rather than after — it may be the answer to what killed the contract. And a cleaner is the cheapest fix on this entire board: the house reads dirty to buyers at 38 lifetime showings. ⛔ DO NOT take a price conversation to this seller off this read — the feedback explicitly does not support one, and the last three reads have blamed schools, EIFS and now condition. Nobody has said the number.
